officialText:
All doors providing access to interior corridors or stairs in occupancy groups R-1 and R-2 shall be equipped with a device that will ensure the door, when opened and released, returns to the closed position and self-latches shut by July 31, 2021.

(L.L. 2018/111, 6/9/2018, eff. 6/9/2018; Am. L.L. 2022/063, 6/1/2022, eff. 7/16/2022 and 11/7/2022)
